description: Calls an external service, waits for a response, and continues the workflow.

inputs.label: Service URL
inputs.description: URL or service identifier resolved by the backend.

inputs.label: Secret Name
inputs.description: Name of a backend environment secret. The secret value is not stored in workflow JSON.

inputs.label: Timeout
inputs.description: Maximum time to wait before taking the timeout/error path.

outputs.label: Success
outputs.description: Continue when the API response matches the success rule.

outputs.label: Error
outputs.description: Continue here on timeout, request failure, or rejected response.
